pieces.o: I think ladybugs are the best bugs to find outside.
r: One reason is that they eat tiny bugs that hurt plants.
Ladybugs are also so bright that they are easy to spot.
Another reason is that they do not sting.
pieces.c: That is why ladybugs are such great bugs.
pieces.f: A ladybug is a kind of beetle.
pieces.d: Many spiders spin sticky webs to catch small bugs.

pieces.o: I think owls are the most interesting birds.
r: One reason is that they can see well in the dark.
Owls can also turn their heads almost all the way around.
Another reason is that they can fly almost without a sound.
pieces.r3b: Owls can fly almost without a sound.
pieces.c: That is why owls are so amazing.
pieces.f: Owls hatch from eggs, like all birds.
pieces.d: Many bats sleep in caves during the day.

pieces.o: Sunflowers are the best flowers to grow.
r: One reason is that they grow taller than a grown-up.
Their seeds are also good food for many birds.
Another reason is that their big yellow petals look like the sun.
pieces.r3b: Their big yellow petals look like the sun.
pieces.c: That is why sunflowers are so great to grow.
pieces.f: Sunflowers need water, like all plants.
pieces.d: Many cows eat grass in big fields.

pieces.o: Penguins are the most fun birds to learn about.
r: One reason is that they swim very fast.
They also waddle when they walk on land.
Another reason is that emperor penguin dads keep their eggs warm.
pieces.r3b: Emperor penguin dads keep their eggs warm.
pieces.c: That is why penguins are such great birds to read books about.
pieces.f: Penguins hatch from eggs, like all birds.
pieces.d: Camels can walk across the hot desert for many days.

pieces.o: I think butterflies are the best bugs to watch.
r: One reason is that their wings have bright colors.
They also drink from flowers with a long tongue.
Another reason is that a caterpillar turns into a butterfly.
pieces.r3b: A caterpillar turns into a butterfly.
pieces.c: That is why butterflies are fun to watch.
pieces.f: Butterflies have six legs, like all other insects.
pieces.d: Snails move very slowly across the ground.

pieces.o: I think bees are the most helpful bugs.
r: One reason is that they help flowers make new seeds.
Honeybees also make the honey that people eat.
Another reason is that bees help farmers grow food.
pieces.c: That is why bees are such important bugs to have around.
pieces.f: Bees have six legs, like all insects.
pieces.d: Wild ducks can swim in ponds and fly over trees.

pieces.o: I think elephants are the most amazing animals on land.
r: One reason is that they can pick things up with their trunks.
They are also the biggest animals on land.
Another reason is that a mother elephant takes good care of her baby.
pieces.r3b: A mother elephant takes good care of her baby.
pieces.c: That is why elephants are such wonderful animals to learn about.
pieces.d: Zebras have black and white stripes on their bodies.

pieces.o: I think oak trees are the best trees for animals.
r: One reason is that squirrels and deer eat their acorns.
Birds also build nests in their branches.
Another reason is that their wide branches give shade.
pieces.c: That is why animals love oak trees so much.
pieces.f: Oak trees have roots, like all trees.
pieces.d: Fish use their fins to swim in the water.

pieces.o: I think frogs are the best animals to watch at a pond.
r: One reason is that they can jump very far.
They also catch bugs with their long, sticky tongues.
Another reason is that tadpoles slowly turn into frogs.
pieces.c: That is why no pond animal is more fun to watch than a frog.
pieces.d: Many horses eat hay in the barn.

pieces.o: I think dolphins are the smartest animals in the sea.
r: One reason is that they work together to catch fish.
Dolphins also call to each other with clicks and whistles.
Another reason is that they can learn new things fast.
pieces.r3b: Dolphins can learn new things fast.
pieces.c: That is why dolphins are such clever animals.
pieces.d: Rabbits have soft fur and long ears.

pieces.o: The moon is the best thing to look at in the night sky.
r: One reason is that it is big and bright.
Its shape also seems to change from night to night.
Another reason is that you can see dark spots on it.
pieces.r3b: You can see dark spots on the moon.
pieces.c: That is why nothing in the night sky is more fun to watch than the moon.
pieces.f: The moon has no air, so people need space suits there.
pieces.d: Blue whales are bigger than any other animal.

pieces.o: I think a rainbow is the best thing to see after it rains.
r: One reason is that it has so many colors.
Rainbows also do not last long, so each one is special.
Another reason is that a rainbow makes a big curve across the sky.
pieces.r3b: A rainbow makes a big curve across the sky.
pieces.c: That is why rainbows are so great to see.
pieces.f: A rainbow is made of light.
pieces.d: Goats like to climb on rocks and hills.

pieces.o: Squirrels are the most fun animals to watch at the park.
r: One reason is that they climb trees very fast.
They also hide nuts to eat later.
Another reason is that they jump from branch to branch.
pieces.r3b: Squirrels jump from branch to branch.
pieces.c: That is why no animal at the park is more fun to watch than a squirrel.
pieces.d: Sheep have thick wool that farmers cut every spring.

pieces.o: I think ants are the hardest-working bugs.
r: One reason is that they can carry things heavier than they are.
Ants also work together to build their homes.
Another reason is that they keep their homes clean.
pieces.c: That is why no bug works harder than a tiny ant does.
pieces.f: Ants have six legs, like all insects.
pieces.d: Bears like to eat berries, fish, and nuts in the woods.

pieces.o: Clouds are the most fun things to look at in the sky.
r: One reason is that they come in so many shapes.
They can also turn pink and orange at sunset.
Another reason is that they change shape as they move.
pieces.r3b: Clouds change shape as they move.
pieces.c: That is why looking at clouds is so much fun.
pieces.f: Clouds are made of tiny drops of water or bits of ice.
pieces.d: Pigs roll in the mud to stay cool.

pieces.o: I think octopuses are the coolest animals in the sea.
r: One reason is that they can taste things with their arms.
They can also change color to hide.
Another reason is that they can squeeze through tiny holes.
pieces.r3b: Octopuses can squeeze through tiny holes.
pieces.c: That is why octopuses are such cool animals.
pieces.d: Crabs walk sideways along the sand.

pieces.o: Giraffes are the most interesting animals in the world.
r: One reason is that they are the tallest animals.
They also eat leaves from the tops of trees.
Another reason is that a baby giraffe can stand soon after it is born.
pieces.r3b: A baby giraffe can stand soon after it is born.
pieces.c: That is why giraffes are such amazing animals.
pieces.d: Lions sleep for many hours in the day.

pieces.o: I think hummingbirds are the best birds to see in a garden.
r: One reason is that they hover in the air like a helicopter.
They can also fly backward and sideways.
Another reason is that their wings move so fast that they hum.
pieces.r3b: Their wings move so fast that they hum.
pieces.c: That is why hummingbirds are such great birds to watch in a garden.
pieces.f: Hummingbirds hatch from eggs, like all birds.
pieces.d: Ducks have webbed feet to help them swim.

body: Thank you for reading us a book about whales.
I liked the part about the baby whale.
Can we read another one soon?
Our class planted bean seeds in cups.
My bean plant has two leaves now.
I will show it to you when it gets big.
I miss you at school.
We learned a new song in music class.
I hope you can come and visit soon.
I lost my first tooth at school today.
The nurse gave me a little box for it.
Now I have a gap in my smile!
Thank you for teaching us to jump rope.
I can jump ten times in a row now.
Gym is so much fun.
Our class went outside to look at clouds.
One cloud looked like a dragon.
What shapes did you see?
Thank you for helping me find a book about frogs.
I read it two times.
Do you have another one?
I can read chapter books now.
My teacher says I read with a lot of feeling.
I want to read one to you.
Thank you for the new swings on the playground.
We take turns on them every day.
They go so high!
Our class has a garden now.
We are growing peas and carrots.
I will save some peas for you.
Thank you for helping us cross the street.
You always wave and smile.
You make our mornings happy.
I saw a big rainbow on the way to school.
It had all the colors in it.
I made a picture of it for you.
My class is learning about bugs.
Did you know that ants have six legs?
What are you learning about?
Thank you for the clay.
I made a little turtle with it.
It is drying on the shelf now.
We had a fire drill today.
Everyone walked out in a line.
The bell was very loud!
Our class read a story about a tortoise and a hare.
The slow tortoise won the race.
Can you guess why?
I missed you when I was sick last week.
I am all better now.
I can’t wait to come back to class.
Thank you for teaching us the drum song.
I practice it on my desk.
Can we play it again next week?

The best part is the snow angels.
